reviewedBy: Codex delivery reconciliation: mechanical implementation review; human CODEOWNERS review remains required
reason: Scoped implementation registration for the frozen agriculture13 source packet and its native generated engines. The linked repository revision is implementation provenance, not an authority or freshness claim. Exact before/after digests and independent test owners are recorded below. No central golden fixture belongs to these six formulas, so fixtureDeltas is empty; all 417 central expectations must remain byte-identical. Existing source metadata, effective periods and lastVerified dates are preserved. No agronomic dataset, statutory rule, application schedule, provider rate or current price is newly certified. Future digest enforcement remains unchanged.

changes.review: Reject invalid or non-finite inputs and unknown identities; remove Nigerian scaled-price defaults for unsupported country/crop/method combinations. Preserve revenue and cost arithmetic, distinguish marketable from harvested break-even yield, include the entered proportional loss in harvested break-even, and use null when a threshold cannot be computed. tests/agric-profit-break-even.test.js and tests/agric-profit-input-boundary.test.js cover independent examples.

Reject malformed or insufficient available-crop lists and unsupported options. Retain existing ranking, crop properties and avoid-rule data; apply existing avoid warnings consistently in reasons, season warnings and aggregate warnings, and restrict suggested intercrops to selected availability. tests/crop-rotation-warning-consistency.test.js and tests/crop-rotation-input-boundary.test.js cover these contracts.

Retain conversion constants and valid-input revenue arithmetic; reject malformed numeric strings, negative costs, unknown crop/unit/currency values and non-finite derived results. tests/crop-yield-tool-engine.test.js preserves existing valid baseline results and adds invalid-input boundaries.

Require known countries and explicit local prices where a country reference is absent; preserve zero-valued user overrides and reject currency mismatches. Allocate 100 percent of the fertilizer cash budget over the two existing payment months instead of 80 percent. Calculate crop-mix break-even from total revenue divided by modeled tonnes, invariant to splitting a crop into rows. Retain existing cost/yield reference data and label references versus entered prices. tests/farm-budget-cashflow.test.js, tests/farm-budget-crop-mix.test.js, tests/farm-budget-local-prices.test.js and tests/farm-budget-input-boundary.test.js provide independent synthetic checks.

Retain existing nutrient targets and soil multipliers. Separate mathematical application amounts from rounded 50 kg bag purchases. Credit compound NPK or DAP nitrogen before calculating supplemental urea; expose supplied nutrients, excess and remaining product. Keep missing quotes unknown and user quotes explicitly unverified. Withdraw the legacy banana timetable that allocates 125 percent of potassium, without inventing a replacement agronomic schedule. tests/fertilizer-calc-engine.test.js covers 6930 profiles plus literal product-plan and quote cases. This is accounting for declared fertilizer grades, not certification of crop requirements, timing, current prices or application advice.

Preserve normal UTC maturity-day addition; format early valid years with four digits and reject invalid or greater-than-9999 output years. No maturity data or weather assumptions changed. tests/harvest-date-engine.test.js covers the date boundary.
